decision: Source-clear for compile-only and four named pure Rust cases through the sole runtime owner; actual HTTP run requires a separate bounded plan
findings: Signed raw body receipt is reused; expectedVersion is exactly one canonical positive i32 plain first field followed by one file and EOF. No cookie or unsigned version header supplies authority.

The decoded request reacquires current capability, explicit native binding, grant and exact session/file selectors in the mutation transaction; the shared core retains owner, expiry, prepared-command and version fences.
Public replacement requires exact version even for unchanged bytes; the native identical-retry policy is explicitly retained.

Stable file identity/position and session order are retained; changed object/derivatives, actual persisted version and byte budget share the same transaction. Public response mapping completes before commit.
Outer exact public route receives bounded image budget and private no-store policy; public file mapping exposes actual DB-backed facts and aliases.
limits: Ignored HTTP test is unexecuted source, not passing evidence.
Revocation tests change grants/binding/admission before requests; after-decode reacquisition is source-supported, not a concurrent runtime observation.
The larger deterministic PNG and aggregate-budget references belong only to the disposable fixture. No publication is performed by the new replacement scenario.
